_comment: Phase 4 — the real Secret Drawer puzzle. Source of truth: Secret-Drawer-Items (NEW2).docx + Secret-Drawer-Playbook.docx (off-repo, on Thomas's Desktop). Background: real photos of Thomas's actual drawer (meme stickers baked in as permanent flavor). Two view states (`junk-*` wide top-down vs `secret-*` close-up of the recessed compartments) × two dust states (clean / dusty) = four surfaces. The wide junk view is the start; chain 8 (padlock) gates the transition to the secret view. Every puzzle item is an engine overlay placed on top. Chains land in commit-sized batches; each chain commit bumps the theme version. The engine's full action-verb surface is documented in the docblock of drawer-engine.js — Phase 4 adds: `video`, `fullscreen`, `passcode`, and `require` (interaction-level flag preconditions). Coordinates were placed in ?author mode and baked back here as the layout pass for each chain batch.

_chains.0-todo: You Got This notebook → click → to-do clue (Find Ring · Tidy drawer · Dust + scribbled notes)
_chains.1-start: screwdriver + screw → dust appears → duster clears it → reveals duck pin (Top Prize path). Leaving dust = Golden Egg path.
_chains.2-hulk: Hulk + hammer → armed Hulk → smash silver nugget → Rings (Find Ring ✓). Torch on Rings → 'one PEZ dispenser to rule them all'. Click PEZ → Auction Receipt ($264M Faberge foreshadow).
_chains.3-duck: Mini Pump + small duck → midway duck → giant duck. Click giant duck → fullscreen browser crush.
_chains.4-scroll: BIC Lighter + Rolled Scroll → Bitcoin whitepaper unfurls as an in-puzzle parchment scroll (engine `scroll:` action renders the PDF page-by-page via lazy-loaded PDF.js). BIC + Jack-o-Lantern → pumpkin lit. The BIC stays in the drawer for both.
_chains.5-hotwheels: STUB until Thomas + Daniel film the bracket. 13.5 sticker (hover hint) + two race cars + Hot Rod collectible. Click any car → 'race video coming soon' clue.
_chains.6-glasses: Ensure (alertness) → Glasses Case → Eyeglasses → combine with Clip-Ons → Sunglasses → click reveals the Elf prelude ('See you again Dec. 1st 2026...'). Fugglers Notebook is the in-puzzle hint for the clip-on combine.
_chains.7-batteries: Car Keys → Toy Train (unlocks battery cover) → AAA Batteries → Train ready → click → chugs. iPhone is direct: click → plays the duct-taped-banana YouTube doc (research that quietly seeds the Golden Egg).
_chains.9-hangman: Combine Sticky Notes + Mechanical Pencil → Hangman mini-game. Word picked from the current month's 20-word rotation (top-level `hangman` block). Win sets flag `hangman-won`. Re-playable.
_chains.10-bible: Click the Antique Book → opens to reveal the Bible. Click the Bible → Proverbs 25:2 clue: 'It is the glory of God to conceal a thing...' — the whole puzzle's thesis.
_chains.12-keepsakes: Spinning Top + Toy Jet. Click each → a sentimental keepsake clue. No interactions between them; just two small artifacts that earn a moment.
_chains.13-marbles: Two marbles. Click each → flavour clue. The footer-marble swap + pinball ball-colour matching is a separate cross-component refactor.
_chains.16-easter: Standalone easter eggs + 'this is me' lore. Astronaut sticker → blackhole effect (engine animation). Kids Camera → PhotoSwipe gallery of 14 actual goofy kid-camera shots (ids 3731–3744 incl. an Elf shot) via the engine's `gallery:` action, then keep/bin. The rest are click→clue flavour beats: Pac-Man arcade (coin-insert + game), Yin-Yang, Ganesha, Shark, Speaker, Bubbles (animated bubbles), Cards, Nivea (toss), Teaspoon, Banana Muffin (eat). Handwritten note has moved to chain 8 (lives in the secret drawer alongside the Ledger).
_chains.8-padlock: Auto-reveal padlock keys when ALL real chain flags are set. Dust state no longer gates the keys (it's pure flavour now — both Top Prize and Golden Egg paths can be reached on the same playthrough). Combine keys + padlock → flip to secret view, reveal Ledger AND the handwritten note (passcode hint). Chain 14 takes it from there. The Golden Egg fork in chain 14 still requires dust-appeared + !dust-cleared so the two terminals remain distinct.
_chains.15-wallet: Flip MFF → reveal 67-sticker. Coins live in the drawer; must be inserted into the Pac-Man arcade first, then go in the wallet. Combine each of: 67-sticker, $20 bills, GP card, coins, auction receipt WITH the Bifold Wallet → goes in. Auto-reveal: when wallet has all FIVE, the 67676767 passcode surfaces (the Ledger's gate, used in chain 14).
_chains.14-prizes: ENDGAME. Banana + Gorilla Tape → Duct-Taped Banana (the hero shot). Click Ledger (secret view, after padlock) → passcode 67676767 → TOP PRIZE (notify). Click duct-banana when all chain flags set + dust-appeared + !dust-cleared → EAT or SELL choice: EAT = GOLDEN EGG (notify); SELL = $6.4M + Faberge video #3727 + BIGGER REWARD (notify).

_hangman_comment: Twenty themed words per month, fed to the Hangman mini-game (chain 9). The engine picks one at random keyed by new Date().getMonth() + 1. Lists from the inventory appendix.

faberge-video._comment: Never rendered on the drawer — only used as the target of the `video:` action when the player sells the banana. State stays hidden; view set to a non-existent bucket so author mode + render skip it.
